customManagers.description: The manager default in cmd/main.go must name the same digest-pinned busybox as the chart's secure.probeImage (TestDefaultProbeImageMatchesChartValue fails the build when they drift); the built-in helm-values manager already owns the chart side, this moves the Go side in the same PR

Every actions/setup-go go-version pin must name the same Go as .mise/config.toml; the built-in mise manager owns that side (github-tags golang/go), this puts the pins on the groupable golang-version datasource so they join the same PR

packageRules.description: One PR per Go toolchain bump: mise's go tool (github-tags golang/go via the built-in mise manager), the workflow go-version pins (golang-version go via the custom manager above), and the Dockerfile's golang base images (docker) all move together
Keep GitHub Actions pinned to readable semver tags, not SHA digests (overrides the shared preset's pinDigests rule)
